rows.name: Published: average of trees and graph network
Check: trees without road type and traffic
Check: terrain, soil and rain only (no road type, traffic or history)

note: Gains are paired against the matching published model on the same days; none is outside the noise (95% ranges include zero), so the published model stays. Road type is by far the strongest feature: the ceiling comes from which roads get flood reports, not from the rain or the graph. Taking road type, traffic and flood history away still leaves AUC 0.908 (top 5%: 54% of floods): most of the skill comes from terrain, soil and rain.
